thread:
Maya Chen: heads-up — seeing a metric aggregation mismatch in the eval harness for orca-12b q8f using the 'assistant-summarize' chat template. overall accuracy drops ~6% vs local run.
Samir Patel: hmm, did CI use the same tokenizer version and chat-template config?
Maya Chen: yes — same config.json pinned in repo. CI logs show different token counts in collate.
Olly Rivera: can you paste the collate snippet? I vaguely remember special-casing assistant persona tokens.
Maya Chen: pasted from ci-worker stdout: ```python
def collate(batch):
    # we prepend `assistant:` sentinel for chat templates
    prefixed = [PERSONA_TOKEN + b['input'] for b in batch]
    # bug: we counted persona token length but didn't include it in metric baseline
    return tokenizer.pad(prefixed, return_tensors='pt')
```
Nina Gomez: oh that comment — we count persona tokens when tokenizing but metric code expects raw input length. that will shift precision/recall thresholds.
Samir Patel: so eval runner computes per-example accuracy using model_output_tokens vs reference_length. if persona/prefix is present only in model input we need to subtract it before len comparison.
Maya Chen: exact. CI-run used v2 of collate where we accidentally introduced the persona prefix only for batch sizes >1 due to fastpath. that explains flaky diffs.
Olly Rivera: quick fix: when counting gold length do `gold_len = len(tokenizer.encode(example['reference']))` and for pred `pred_len = len(pred_tokens) - persona_len_if_present`. can someone open a tiny PR?
Rachel Li: I'll open it and add a unit test for batch_size 1/4 with and without persona token.
CI Bot: re-run triggered: pipeline/ci-eval-harness #4821 — started by Rachel Li :gear:
Maya Chen: also noticing quantized run (q8f) exaggerated the drift because logits rounding altered tokenization boundary near persona token. not a harness logic bug, but it amplified the metric delta.
Samir Patel: makes sense. add a note in the PR about quantization sensitivity so we don't misattribute to models.
Rachel Li: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-ml/pulls/1342 — fixes collate counting, adds tests, and a one-off script to diff old vs new metric outputs.
Olly Rivera: will run the one-off diff on the failing CI artifacts once pipeline finishes.
Nina Gomez: set a guard in the metric aggregator to log when persona_token presence != expected, so we can triage quickly next time. small change but helps oncall.
Maya Chen: thanks y'all. if CI pass, I'll re-run the full eval matrix including k-shot prompts. will post summary here. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: pipeline/ci-eval-harness #4821 — succeeded (14m 12s)
Maya Chen: CI green. diff script shows most deltas <0.2% except orca-12b-q8f/chat-template where earlier run had -5.8% accuracy; fixed run shows parity within 0.3%.
Samir Patel: great catch. leaving an action item to add chat-template persona test vector to nightly regression suite.
Rachel Li: added to backlog and set owners (Maya + Nina).
Maya Chen: filing a short postmortem on the flake and adding a note in the onboarding docs about persona-token handling.
Olly Rivera: nice work :tada:
Maya Chen: thanks — closing the loop here.
